brief.greeting: Good morning. You’ve got a retro PC on an FPGA, a 100‑line AI bug‑fixer, and a video‑talking Claude—all before your first coffee.

stories.headline: FPGA resurrects 1985 AT&T UNIX PC
stories.body: **Old school meets new silicon:** Hackaday’s MiSTer port runs the original 10 MHz CPU inside a 18 kg chassis replica. It’s a faithful hardware‑level throwback for hobbyists.
stories.why: Shows how FPGA can preserve legacy systems for modern tinkering.

stories.headline: Mini‑SWE‑Agent cracks GitHub issues
stories.body: **Tiny but mighty:** A 100‑line Python script solves issues with over 74% accuracy on the SWE‑bench suite. It’s a lightweight alternative to heavyweight code assistants.
stories.why: Provides a quick, open‑source way to automate issue triage.

stories.headline: Claude‑video turns any clip into prompts
stories.body: **Video‑first Claude workflow:** The repo downloads a video, extracts frames and audio, then feeds the combined data to Claude for analysis. No extra services required.
stories.why: Enables developers to add multimodal AI to apps without building pipelines from scratch.

quick_hits.text: **CLI**: Google Colab now has a command‑line client for launching runtimes.
**OSINT**: Shadowbroker aggregates jet, satellite, and seismic data into a searchable database.
**Starter**: Claude‑quickstarts offers ready‑made projects for the Claude API.
**Model**: TwIL‑8B text generator has 22 k downloads on Hugging Face.
**Alarm**: A privacy‑first smart clock shows weather and photos without cloud services.

brief.sign_off: That’s your tech bite—see you tomorrow, wink.

highlights.title: An FPGA Version of the AT&T UNIX PC for MiSTer
highlights.summary: An FPGA recreation of the 1985 AT&T UNIX PC for the MiSTer platform replicates the original 10 MHz CPU and 18 kg chassis.
highlights.detail: The project targets retro‑computing enthusiasts, enabling the classic UNIX workstation to run on modern FPGA hardware within the MiSTer ecosystem. It preserves the original architecture while offering easier access.

highlights.title: googlecolab/google-colab-cli
highlights.summary: googlecolab/google-colab-cli is a command‑line interface for controlling Google Colab runtimes.
highlights.detail: The tool enables users to start, stop, and list notebooks, upload files, and execute cells without opening a browser, streamlining automation workflows for Python developers.

highlights.title: BigBodyCobain/Shadowbroker
highlights.summary: BigBodyCobain/Shadowbroker aggregates open‑source intelligence on assets like private jets, satellites, and seismic events into a single searchable platform.
highlights.detail: It provides APIs and optional AI agents to parse the collected data for hidden correlations, aiming to democratize access to otherwise fragmented OSINT resources.

highlights.title: SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent
highlights.summary: SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent is a 100‑line AI tool that solves GitHub issues and achieves over 74% accuracy on the SWE‑bench verification suite.
highlights.detail: The agent runs without extensive configuration or large monorepos, interacting via the command line. Its lightweight design makes it easy to integrate into developer workflows for automated issue triage.

highlights.title: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
highlights.summary: anthropics/claude-quickstarts offers example projects to help developers quickly build deployable applications using the Claude API.
highlights.detail: The collection includes starter code for chatbots, data pipelines, and web services, illustrating best practices for authentication, request handling, and scaling with Claude.

items.title: Model: PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy
items.summary: Model PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy is a text-to-image model on Hugging Face with 625,136 downloads and 258 likes.
items.detail: The model is part of the HF trending list and targets image generation from textual prompts. Its popularity reflects strong community interest, though no licensing or size details are provided.

items.title: Model: webAI-Official/TwIL-8B
items.summary: Model webAI-Official/TwIL-8B is a text-generation model on Hugging Face with 22,737 downloads and 243 likes.
items.detail: TwIL-8B offers an 8‑billion‑parameter language model for generating text, listed among HF trending models. It has attracted moderate attention, but performance metrics are not disclosed.

items.title: A Smart Alarm Clock That Doesn’t Sell Your Soul
items.summary: A smart alarm clock design provides weather, photos, and time without relying on Google or Amazon services.
items.detail: The device uses local processing and optional open‑source integrations to avoid data collection, offering a privacy‑focused alternative to commercial smart speakers that double as alarms.

items.title: Custom Game Boy Cart Speeds Up Development
items.summary: A custom flash cartridge for Game Boy speeds up development by allowing direct code loading without soldering.
items.detail: The cartridge plugs into the console’s cartridge slot and can be programmed via USB, reducing iteration time for hobbyists and homebrew developers working on Game Boy software.

items.title: Determining Location by Listening for Airplanes
items.summary: A method determines a photo’s location by analyzing recorded airplane sounds and matching them to flight data.
items.detail: By extracting audio frequencies and timestamps, the technique cross‑references commercial flight databases to infer geographic coordinates, offering a covert geolocation tool beyond visual metadata.

items.title: Lillith Tells Your Future
items.summary: Lillith Tells Your Future is a hackathon‑style guide for building an animated fortune‑telling device reminiscent of Zoltar.
items.detail: The tutorial walks through hardware selection, microcontroller programming, and visual output to create an interactive novelty. It targets hobbyists familiar with retro arcade aesthetics and provides source files for replication.

items.title: Saving a Vintage High-Voltage Power Supply From the Scrap Heap
items.summary: Mr Carlson’s Lab restores a Fluke Model 407 high‑voltage power supply, documenting troubleshooting steps to fix its output.
items.detail: The article details diagnostic measurements, component replacements, and safety precautions for vintage equipment. It serves as a reference for engineers maintaining legacy test gear.

items.title: bradautomates/claude-video
items.summary: bradautomates/claude-video lets Claude process any video by downloading it, extracting frames, transcribing audio, and feeding the combined data to Claude.
items.detail: The tool automates the end‑to‑end pipeline so users can ask Claude questions about video content without manual preprocessing. It supports common video formats and uses local transcription models. The repository is Python‑based and open‑source.

items.title: dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker
items.summary: dashdogy/MFG-Unlocker adds DLSS Multi Frame Generation unlocking and control features for any supported MFG title on RTX series GPUs.
items.detail: The utility works by intercepting the game's rendering pipeline to enable MFG where it is otherwise disabled. It provides a simple UI for toggling the feature and adjusting parameters. Compatibility is limited to RTX GPUs that support DLSS.
